Prepare step by step

  1. Identify whether the question belongs to the provider, insurer, pharmacy or records office.
  2. Keep account, member, medical and financial details off this page.
  3. Write down each charge, service date or record question privately.
  4. Request written explanations and escalation routes from the responsible organization.
